summary: H06E rejects terminal-control, diagnostic, semantic, version and re-signed authority drift while preserving the one exact known warning.
facts: Independent attacks rejected all 64 ASCII/C1 control codepoints except the single allowed LF, including NUL, BS, TAB, CR, ESC and U+009B.
Seven malformed PATH-warning variants, unknown stderr, nonzero return codes, arity errors, ANSI, semantic help drift and missing tokens fail closed.
Old, future, substring and alias versions plus re-signed help, profile, broker, shared-contract, runtime-tree and generation drift remain rejected.
